NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager plans to eat a whole ripe mango tomorrow without getting a single drop of juice on their chin.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: It's late, and (name1) is lying on (his/her) sleeping mat making a plan for tomorrow. It isn't a big plan. Tomorrow, (name1) is going to eat a mango, a whole ripe one, without getting a single drop of juice on (his/her) chin. (He/she) has never once managed it. (He/she) has thought it through: a knife, small pieces, a bowl, leaning forward. (He/she) falls asleep feeling quietly confident. The next day, at lunch, (he/she) cuts the mango into small pieces, leans forward over the bowl, takes the first bite with great care, and immediately gets juice on (his/her) chin, (his/her) nose and, somehow, (his/her) left ear. (He/she) sits there, dripping, and starts to laugh. There's always tomorrow. There are a lot of mangoes.
